description: An original universe: on the inside surface of a hollow world lit by a captive star, people can extract memories, store them in resonant crystals, and burn them as fuel for gravity manipulation. Forgetting is the price of power. Memory-brokers, archivist orders and the Forgotten (people who sold too much) shape society. I begin as a memory-courier who has sold one childhood summer.

core.name: The Hollowed Light
core.tagline: Where memory is gravity, and forgetting is the only fuel.

core.intro: You stand in the dim glow of a memory vault beneath the cracked stone of the Hollowed Light, your fingers trembling as you hold the cold, vibrating crystal that once held the scent of pine, the sound of laughter, and the warmth of your mother’s hand. The walls hum with low frequencies, and you know — the gravity in this chamber has shifted since you last came. You’ve sold it all. That summer. physics: The world is hollow, with a single star trapped inside its inner surface, casting light from within. This creates a stable, ever-present illumination — the 'Hos
common_knowledge: Memory is gravity. Without memory, there is no gravity.
To forget is to become lighter — and sometimes, unanchored.
The Forgotten live in the dark, their bodies failing to hold memory, their minds drifting like dust in a vacuum.

magic.summary: No magic. All power comes from memory. Memories are extracted through neural resonance, stored in resonant crystals, and burned to alter gravitational fields. No spells, no incantations, no unexplained forces.

special_rules.name: Burn Memory to Move
special_rules.summary: You can burn a memory fuel amber to instantly travel to a known settlement, reducing travel time from 3 days to 1 day.

on_success.text: You arrive at the destination, refreshed and energized.

on_failure.text: You lose the memory fuel, and feel a dull ache in your mind as if something is missing.

special_rules.name: Resonance Anchor
special_rules.summary: Place a crystal gear pendant near a memory source (e.g. a person's mind) to strengthen the memory’s clarity and durability. Use once per day.

on_success.text: You generate a single memory parchment with a vivid, clear image of the original memory.

on_failure.text: The pendant vibrates and breaks. You feel a brief disorientation.

on_success.text: You detect a memory leak near the Spire — a forgotten memory is leaking into the gravity field.

on_failure.text: The crank handle shatters and you feel a wave of dizziness as gravity pulls incorrectly.
